Manfred Clauss, The Roman Cult of Mithras: The God and His Mysteries (tr. R. Gordon, Routledge 2000)
Standard monograph on the iconography, grades, ritual and diffusion of the Roman Mithraic mysteries.
Roger Beck, The Religion of the Mithras Cult in the Roman Empire: Mysteries of the Unconquered Sun (Oxford 2006)
Cognitive/astronomical interpretation of the tauroctony, the mithraeum as cosmos, the grades and the Sun-Mithras relationship.
